title: Ginger Minj crowned Tournament of All Stars winner
summary: In the All Stars 10 finale (AS-S10-E12), Ginger Minj and Jorgeous lip-synced to The Weather Girls' "It's Raining Men". Ginger won the Lip Sync Smackdown for the Crown, the $200,000 prize, and Hall of Fame induction — the first contestant to win any Drag Race franchise season on a fourth attempt after Season 7, All Stars 2, and All Stars 6.

title: Tournament of All Stars bracket format debuts
summary: All Stars 10 introduced the Tournament of All Stars: eighteen queens competed in three brackets of six across three episodes each. Top 2 queens earned points and lip-synced for an extra legacy point and $10,000, while non-Top queens awarded Most Valuable Queen points. The top three point-earners from each bracket advanced to two semifinal episodes with traditional eliminations, then a Lip Sync Smackdown for the Crown.

title: Kerri Colby returns via Wildcard Lottery
summary: After elimination in Bracket 2, Kerri Colby was chosen by Ts Madison and Michelle Visage (over Ross Mathews' pick of Mistress Isabelle Brooks) and won the Wildcard Lottery to re-enter for the finale Smackdown for the Crown. She lost her first-round lip sync to Ginger Minj to Lady Gaga's "Disease".
